premium.basis: vs last close before announcement (Dec 6, 2019 close of $9.67); board considered premium relative to pre-proposal trading range of $7.88-$9.67

value_inflection_events.event: Deal announcement at $20.00 per share and ASH data release

leaked_early.details: General takeover speculation reported in June 2019 and November 2019, but no specific buyer or price leaked.

notes: Merck shifted from co-development partnership talks to full acquisition of ArQule to secure lead asset ARQ 531, with no other bidders actively pursuing a transaction at the time of the deal.
